title: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Record and Retention Concessions on Parking Rent Increases
content:
**Rule.** In a retention concession on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement, an AutoPay adjustment is applied to the share of the increase given back, according to the agreement's Bluegate AutoPay Authorization:

- **3 percentage points are added** where the agreement's AutoPay authorization stands active and none of its drafts was declined for insufficient funds in the last 6 months;
- **2 percentage points are taken off** where the authorization stands suspended and was suspended in the last 6 months;
- nothing changes in every other case.

The adjustment goes into the one combined share that is applied once to the increase. A window of the last 6 months covers drafts and suspensions dated less than 6 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month.

**Records read.** The Bluegate AutoPay Authorization on this parking agreement: its status (active or suspended), its suspension date, and its drafts' results and draft dates.

**Questions and answers (hypothetical).**

- *Authorization active; a draft declined for insufficient funds 4 months ago.* Not clean in the window and not suspended: nothing changes.
- *Authorization active; the only insufficient-funds decline was 7 months ago.* 3 points added.
- *Authorization suspended 2 months ago.* 2 points taken off.
- *Authorization suspended 9 months ago and still suspended.* Outside the 6-month window: nothing changes.
- *No AutoPay authorization on the agreement.* Nothing changes.

Worked figure: a share of 52% with 3 points added becomes 55%; with 2 points taken off it becomes 50%.
